Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Project Manager to join our growing Medical Affairs team!  

The Project Manager is responsible for delivering assigned medical affairs projects from initiation through final closeout, including planning, coordination, budget management, routing, approvals, and launch of project deliverables. Projects may include slide decks, print projects, congress materials, advisory board materials, scientific communications, and smaller digital initiatives. This role serves as a main point of contact across internal and external teams, partnering closely with Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, User Experience, Technology, and Quality Assurance partners to keep work on time, on budget, and aligned to client expectations.

Whether it’s bringing in the right resources at the right time, aligning priorities with the account team, or identifying bottlenecks and proposing solutions early, no two days are the same.  

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago or Indianapolis—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily work Eastern business hours.

What you’ll do:  

  • Clearly communicate expectations to internal teams and vendors to support the efficient flow of work throughout the agency.
  • Partner with key agency teams to ensure projects stay on track and agreed-upon milestones are met, including Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, Strategic Planning, Information UX, Technology, and Programming teams.
  • Plan, schedule, and monitor work to meet timeline, budget, and quality goals in accordance with relevant guidelines. 
  • Collaborate with finance and accounting teams on revenue recognition/invoicing processes 
  • Participate in client and stakeholder meetings as needed, with a clear understanding of project status and timelines to respond to relevant questions and provide project updates when appropriate.
  • Perform risk planning and mitigation to minimize project risk. 
  • Help create service or departmental standard operating procedures 
  • Route deliverables to appropriate core team members for review and signoff via the electronic project routing system.  
  • Ensure signoff prior to key milestones, including core team review, medical/scientific review, client review, vendor handoff, and final release.
  • Develop detailed work plans, schedules, and status reports to keep internal teams, clients, and external partners aligned throughout the project life cycle. 
  • Serve as a day-to-day project lead, helping define scope and objectives while motivating cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. 
  • Coordinate project deliverables from concept through delivery, ensuring the appropriate internal departments, reviews, approvals, and handoffs are engaged at each stage. 
  • Support adherence to agency process and manage the quality assurance phase for all projects.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are a highly organized self-starter who can work independently and manage tight deadlines.

What you should have:  

  • 3+ years of Project/Program Management or relevant experience. 
  • 2+ years of experience in budget management. 
  • Working familiarity with industry-specific processes, including medical, legal, regulatory, and client review.
  • Background working on teams focused on medical affairs, scientific communications, medical education, or related non-promotional healthcare communications projects.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading small- to medium-scale projects from conception through completion. 
  • Experience working cross-functionally with medical/scientific, editorial, account, creative, and project management partners to deliver high-quality products and services. 
  • Proficient in creating timelines and tracking progress against schedules.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with technical and non-technical teams across multiple business areas; excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

title: AI Solutions Program Manager, Finance
description:
Who we are  

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

You'll be joining the Finance Operational Excellence team, reporting to the Head of Finance Operational Excellence. We are finance transformation and AI experts working side-by-side with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to redefine processes and build the finance organization of the future. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across disciplines: part solution developer, part data architect, part workflow designer, and part coach. You’ll have room to shape how applied AI is built and scaled both from a technical and end-user perspective.

What you’ll do

You'll work side-by-side with Finance subject matter experts to understand how work gets done, identify the highest impact opportunities, and partner with domain teams to chart a transformation plan which balances future ambitions with rapid impact.  You'll work independently to automate manual processes, design and build agents and required data solutions using internal platforms, and enable Finance teams to maintain these solutions long-term. 

You’ll build with your partner teams, not simply deliver solutions to them. You’ll help colleagues move from a manual workflow, to a first AI-enabled win, to a reliable solution they can confidently operate and improve themselves. Success means the workflow stays transformed after the initial build, the team trusts the output, and the people closest to the process can own what comes next. 

You’ll favor learning through building. When possible, you’ll put a useful prototype in front of a Finance user, test it against a real deliverable, and improve it quickly rather than spend weeks describing a theoretical future state. When you encounter platform limitations—which you will—you’ll find creative, supportable approaches, collaborate with Engineering to scope and test custom tools, and escalate strategically when needed.

This role requires a blend of process automation, data operations, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder enablement. You'll spend your time building agents, optimizing data pipelines that feed them, creating knowledge layers that make them more accurate, and training Finance teams to use and maintain them. Success means Finance teams can independently run agents you've built while you provide light support and focus on the next automation opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Embed with Finance teams to diagnose workflows, identify high-leverage opportunities, and translate business, data, and control requirements into practical AI and automation solutions.
  • Build and operationalize AI agents for Finance use cases, delivering end-to-end solutions from prototype through validation, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.
  • Write and optimize SQL for data extraction, transformation, calculation, and validation, ensuring Finance-facing outputs are accurate, explainable, and reliable.
  • Design reusable knowledge layers, evaluation methods, validation patterns, data-quality frameworks, and components that improve agent accuracy and accelerate future use cases.
  • Identify agentic limitations and new possibilities; determine when to use existing capabilities, develop an alternative approach, or partner with Engineering to scope and test custom tools and integrations, including tools using Model Context Protocol where appropriate.
  • Build alongside users, gather feedback through real deliverables, and iterate until the solution fits the workflow and earns user trust.
  • Enable long-term ownership through clear SOPs, runbooks, training, and self-service tooling; coach Finance teams to operate, maintain, and evolve what has been built.
  • Establish monitoring and observability for deployed agents, including metrics, alerting, and incident-response processes that support reliable operation.
  • Diagnose technical and data issues, resolve problems independently where possible, and collaborate with Engineering when solutions require deeper platform changes.
  • Measure adoption and impact, share lessons and wins, and turn successful implementations into standards, components, and playbooks for the broader Finance AI portfolio.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, technical operations, business intelligence, automation, solutions delivery, or a related field.
  • Of which, 2+ years of experience in program management, working directly alongside business leaders to develop and execute process transformation programs
  • Hands-on experience building AI-enabled tools, agents, automations, or workflows that changed a real business process—not solely using AI as a conversational tool, 
  • Strong SQL proficiency, including experience writing complex queries using CTEs, window functions, and joins for data analysis, transformation, or pipeline logic.
  • A track record of independently scoping and delivering technical solutions for process improvement, demonstrating ownership from problem definition through adoption.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, including the ability to identify root causes, debug complex data problems, and resolve inconsistencies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and work effectively with domain experts and Engineering partners.
  • Experience teaching, coaching, enabling users, or transferring ownership of a solution through documentation, training, or self-service tools.
  • Working knowledge of development practices such as version control, testing, code review, and iterative delivery.
  • Experience using low-code tools, scripting, workflow automation, AI-assisted development, or custom integrations, paired with curiosity and the ability to learn evolving technologies.

You will also likely have (not required):

  • Domain experience in Finance Operations, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Payments, or other areas.
  • Familiarity with modern data tools and practices, such as Python, Databricks, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol or another extensibility or integration framework.
  • Experience navigating financial systems and understanding how data flows through accounting, reporting, reconciliation, forecasting, or payments processes.
  • Experience with change management, organizational transformation, or large-scale enablement programs.
  • Experience building internal tools, templates, components, or playbooks that were adopted beyond the original team or use case.
  • Experience working in a high-growth technology company with rapidly evolving processes and tools.

Note on technical depth: This role involves working at the intersection of no-code AI tools and custom development. While software engineering expertise is not required, you should be comfortable applying technical concepts, collaborating closely with Engineering teams, and using AI-assisted development tools to extend platform capabilities when needed.

Job Summary: 

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team! 

The Manager, Paid Social is responsible for social campaign paid planning, strategy, execution, implementation, and delivery to meet client objectives. 

You’ll be the day-to-day partner to strategy & account teams and will leverage your knowledge of paid social media to support strategy development and delivery. You will activate omni-channel, digital first marketing and advertising campaigns for our clients, leveraging your capabilities in managing paid social media, dynamic ad creative, personalization, and integrated digital media programs.

  • Provide proactive recommendations on research findings, campaign results, industry trends and innovation, competitive pressures to keep clients informed and manage programs upon best practices of paid social media 
  • Ability to understand key metrics and utilize data and analytics to inform trading strategies and campaign management approach 
  • Build close partnerships with media partners and understand the ecosystem from demand, supply, verification, measurement etc. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

  • 1-3 years of experience managing paid social media and being a hands-on trader, managing a client’s performance marketing/advertising-driven activities across multiple social platforms 
  • Preference for experience in pharma/healthcare industry, but not required - must have strong knowledge of the platforms and data used to support and measure the overall performance of the campaign 
  • Proficiency with social media buying platforms: Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Reddit Ads, X Ads etc. - Meta Blueprint, X Ads Academy/Twitter Flight School and Google Certifications a plus  
  • Display an in-depth understanding of the functionality, strategies behind social media driven campaigns and best practices of all major social platforms 
  • Exceptional project management skills: demonstrated ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines, prioritize and manage detailed budgets 
  • Ability to work well under pressure and to build relationships with internal teams 
  • Work related diversity, equity and inclusion involvement a plus

Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions. Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale. Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition. Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities. Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions. You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions. You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value. You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments. You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined. You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority. You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences. You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake. You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment. Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country.  Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere.

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

The Opportunity

The Customer Success Manager will sit within the Success team on the Partner Insights, Enablement and Success team. This role will own strategic customer relationships with healthcare systems, life sciences organizations, and research partners, helping customers translate complex clinical questions into successful real-world data and evidence workflows. The ideal candidate combines enterprise healthcare technology customer success experience - especially experience with EMR data or EMR vendors - with a strong foundation in clinical practice, real-world data or evidence, public health, outcomes research, or epidemiology. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own a portfolio of Truveta customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, research execution, renewal readiness, and expansion. Develop success plans, establish measurable outcomes, and ensure customers realize sustained value from Truveta. 
  • Guide customers through research and analytics workflows, including cohort definition, feasibility assessment, study design considerations, data interpretation, and effective use of Truveta products and services. 
  • Translate customer goals, clinical workflows, and research questions into clear requirements, action plans, and deliverables. Coordinate across product, research, engineering, commercial, and support teams to drive resolution and progress. 
  • Manage customer education, enablement, training, and stakeholder and executive-ready communications. Clearly summarize research findings, product capabilities, risks, and recommendations in Truveta-branded reports, slide decks, and presentations. 
  • Build trusted relationships with clinical, operational, informatics, analytics, and research stakeholders at health systems and life sciences organizations. Serve as a strategic advisor and customer advocate. 
  • Identify opportunities to deepen product adoption and expand customer impact. Partner with commercial teams on account planning, renewal preparation, and growth opportunities. 
  • Proactively identify delivery, workflow, or adoption risks and develop practical recommendations for resolution.

Required Skills:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, consulting, ideally with a focus on life science or healthcare analytics customers. 
  • Demonstrated experience with public health research, epidemiology, outcomes research, health services research, real-world data (RWD), real-world evidence (RWE), or clinical research. 
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to align clinical, technical, operational, and executive audiences around shared goals and deliverables. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain scientific, analytical, and technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of familiarity. 
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, navigate ambiguity, and manage multiple customer priorities simultaneously. 
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to timely, high-quality execution. 
  • High degree of professionalism, curiosity, empathy, and enthusiasm for Truveta's mission of Saving Lives with Data. 
  • Direct experience working at an EMR vendor, or substantial experience implementing, supporting, or advising customers on Epic or Cerner platforms and workflows is an absolute plus.

Preferred Qualifications: 

These qualifications are preferred but not required, please do not let them stop you from applying for this role. You will likely get the opportunity to learn how to do these more advanced analyses if you don’t already have experience with them.  

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in public health, epidemiology, health services research, biomedical informatics, biostatistics, health economics, or another quantitative or health-related discipline.

  • Experience with clinical data models, EHR workflows, interoperability, population health, registries, analytics, or clinical informatics. 
  • Experience with statistical analysis or querying tools such as SQL, R, Python, or similar technologies.

Wir starten bei Bedarf mit Analysen & Audits, planen und entwickeln die Software und betreiben die Umgebungen. Wir haben feste Standorte in Deutschland (Nordrhein-Westfalen und Berlin). Gemeinsam mit unserer Gruppengesellschaft in Vietnam entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Kundenlösungen. Unser Portfolio umfasst insbesondere Cloud-Solution-Provider-(CSP)-Services (insbesondere Azure), Build-Operate-Transfer-(BOT)-Modelle, individuelle Softwareentwicklung sowie End-to-End-Transformationsprojekte von On-Premises- zu Cloud-Lösungen. Wir verfolgen einen konsequenten Cloud-First- und KI-getriebenen Ansatz und verbinden Business-Analyse, Projektmanagement und Managed Services , um skalierbare und zukunftssichere Lösungen für unsere Kunden bereitzustellen. Um unsere nächste Wachstumsphase zu beschleunigen, suchen wir eine*n Growth Manager (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle übersetzt du unsere Fähigkeiten in ein klares, skalierbares Marktangebot und baust gemeinsam mit uns nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum auf. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Du arbeitest direkt an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmenswachstums – von der Strukturierung des Produkt- und Serviceportfolios über Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten bis hin zur Verbesserung unserer Vertriebs- und Wachstumsprozesse. Dein Ziel: Du hilfst dabei, aus Coduct ein klar positioniertes, skalierbares Angebot zu machen und dafür zu sorgen, dass dieses Angebot zunehmend einfacher, reproduzierbarer und erfolgreicher verkauft werden kann. Die Rolle ist bewusst als Entwicklungsschritt angelegt: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für eigene Themen und wächst mit zunehmender Erfahrung in strategische und bereichsübergreifende Verantwortung hinein. Deine Verantwortungsbereiche Wachstum & Umsatzsteuerung Du bist Teil des Teams, das für das ganzheitliche Unternehmenswachstum verantwortlich ist: Umsatz, Pipeline, Neukundengewinnung und Expansion Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Go-to-Market-Strategien Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung unserer Sales-Modelle (CSP, BOT, Projektgeschäft) Sicherstellung hoher Conversion Rates entlang der gesamten Customer Journey 2. Produktportfolio (Core Focus) Analyse bestehender Services und Kundenprojekte und Identifikation von Mustern für wiederholbare Angebote Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg*innen entwickelst du Angebote zu skalierbaren, leicht verständlichen Packages, Services und Produkten weiter Mitwirkung bei Positionierung, Pricing und Differenzierung vom Wettbewerb Recherche neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Zielsegmente sowie Validierung erster Hypothesen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Delivery und Technologie , um die Machbarkeit sicherzustellen 3. Kommunikation & Go-to-Market (Outreach) Du hilfst dabei, unser Portfolio klar zu kommunizieren – Website / Landing Pages, Sales Decks und Angebotsstrukturen Aufbau einer konsistenten Story : „Was machen wir?“, „Für wen?“, „Warum wir?“ Unterstützung bei Outreach-Aktivitäten und Übernahme ausgewählter Initiativen – Direct Sales, Partnerschaften, Marketing / Content Definition von Zielsegmenten sowie Testen und Weiterentwickeln einfacher, wiederholbarer Sales-Prozesse 4. Cross-funktionale Steuerung Zusammenarbeit mit Sales / Business Development, Marketing, Product / Offering und Delivery Unterstützung bei der Definition gemeinsamer KPIs und OKRs sowie Nachhalten der Umsetzung Informationen und Learnings teamübergreifend vernetzen und nutzbar machen Schrittweise Übernahme der Verantwortung für bereichsübergreifende Growth-Themen 5. Data & Performance Aufbau und Pflege eines einfachen, klaren KPI-Reportings für Pipeline, Conversion Rates, Deal Size / ACV und weitere relevante Kennzahlen Nutzung von Daten zur Priorisierung und Verbesserung von Initiativen Kontinuierliches Testen und Optimieren von Funnels und Angeboten Dein Einfluss (KPIs) Erfolg wird vor allem gemessen an: Beitrag zum Umsatzwachstum (Neu + Bestand) Qualität und Größe der Pipeline Verbesserung der Conversion entlang der Customer Journey Skalierbarkeit des Portfolios (Anteil standardisierter Angebote) Time-to-Sale / Sales-Effizienz Anzahl funktionierender Go-to-Market-MechanikenBeitrag neuer Angebote zum Gesamtumsatz Qualifikation Erfahrung Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in B2B Sales, Growth oder Business Development und Go-to-Market – idealerweise in Software-/Cloud-Beratung und Professional Services Interesse daran, individuelle Kundenlösungen in klare und wiederholbare Angebote zu überführen Erste Erfahrung darin, Strategien in konkrete Maßnahmen und messbare Ergebnisse zu übersetzen Du musst noch keine vollständige Growth-Funktion aufgebaut oder ein Unternehmen geführt haben – Lernagilität, Ownership und sichtbares Entwicklungspotenzial sind wichtiger Skills & Mindset Du nutzt **KI-**gestützte Werkzeuge sicher und sinnvoll, um Analysen, Konzepte und operative Arbeit zu beschleunigen Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von Software-, IT- und Beratungs-Geschäftsmodellen Erfahrung in der Produktisierung von Services Stark darin, komplexe Themen zu strukturieren und klar zu kommunizieren Proaktiv, mit “ Bias for Action” und ergebnisorientiert Starke Leadership- und Organisationsfähigkeiten in dynamischen Umgebungen Unternehmerisches Denken und Kundenorientierung Das Potenzial und die Motivation, in den nächsten Jahren deutlich mehr strategische und Leadership-Verantwortung zu übernehmen Sprachen: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und fließendes Englisch Entwicklungsperspektive Wir suchen bewusst keine fertige Persönlichkeit auf Head-Level. Wir suchen jemanden, der hungrig, neugierig und in der Lage ist, sich in den nächsten Jahren bei Coduct zu einer führenden Growth-Persönlichkeit zu entwickeln . Du übernimmst eigene Themen, arbeitest eng mit dem Management und erfahrenen Kolleg*innen zusammen und erweiterst schrittweise deine strategische und operative Verantwortung

description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

title: CX Operations Enablement Specialist
description:
Who we are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators, and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who you are

Metropolis is seeking a CX Operations Enablement Specialist to serve as the operational translator and steward of our Customer Experience knowledge ecosystem. In this role, you will tear down process friction, embed our "Trust-First" support philosophy, and ensure our frontline human agents and AI support tools have access to highly accurate, empathetic, and actionable information. Partnering closely with Operations, Product, QA, Training, and AI Strategy teams, you will architect SOPs, manage our knowledge libraries, and empower support teams to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the operational owner of Customer Experience knowledge, managing the customer-facing Help Center and internal Knowledge Library
  • Lead the comprehensive teardown and rebuild of legacy SOPs, replacing rigid policies with workflows anchored in our core framework: Acknowledge, Empathize, Verify, Resolve
  • Build localized, compliant SOPs and decision trees for complex operational workflows, such as Dynamic Pricing disputes and 3rd-Party Reservation failures
  • Own, restructure, and maintain the Gladly CRM macro library (CX Answers) and FAQs to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) while aligning with the Metropolis brand voice
  • Serve as the primary CX liaison to Operations Launch teams, ensuring localized knowledge assets and documentation are delivered prior to go-live for new locations
  • Act as the direct operational bridge to Experience Integrity and Government Relations to establish strictly compliant agent guardrails for regulatory-sensitive workflows
  • Structure organizational knowledge clearly so it can be effectively ingested and retrieved by our AI Agent (Parker) and internal LLMs
  • Partner with CX AI Content Analysts to close documentation gaps that cause AI hallucinations or routing failures
  • Conduct recurring knowledge audits to identify gaps, partnering with QA and Training to ensure operational alignment

What we're looking for

  • Experience managing or maintaining knowledge bases, help centers, or complex SOP documentation systems such as Gladly, Zendesk, Guru, or Confluence
  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, or a fast-paced operational environment
  • Strong technical writing, editing, and documentation skills with a hyper-focus on clarity, empathy, and usability
  • Ability to translate complex, localized operational and legal requirements into user-friendly documentation for frontline BPO agents
  • Strong project management skills, specifically in driving cross-functional alignment ahead of strict launch deadlines
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high-output processes

While not required, these are a plus:

  • Experience supporting AI-powered customer support solutions or familiarity with generative AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT
  • Experience with Gladly, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar CRM platforms
  • Experience creating customer support documentation at scale
  • Understanding of information architecture, content strategy, and knowledge management best practices

4 Days in Office: Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection

When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $63,000.00 USD to $75,000.00 USD annually. The actual base salary offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base salary is one component of Metropolis' total compensation package, which may also include access to or eligibility for healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans, and more. #LI-AW1 #LI-Onsite

Metropolis may utilize an automated employment decision tool (AEDT) to assess or evaluate your candidacy for employment or promotion. AEDTs are used to assist in assessing a candidate’s application relative to the required job qualifications and responsibilities listed in the job posting.

As part of this process, Metropolis retains data relevant to your candidacy, including personal information, for a period that is reasonably necessary for the use of the tool. If you are hired for the position, your data may become part of your employee records.

Metropolis Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs — without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.

We are committed to providing a welcoming, accessible hiring experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please reach out to us at recruiting@metropolis.io.

title: Lead Front End Architect/Engineer
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future.

We are hiring a Lead Engineer, Front End to lead the architecture and hands-on delivery of the interfaces our customers use to build and manage HCP journeys. You will lead front-end engineering, hire and grow the team behind it, and partner closely with the back end lead and product designer so the platform's interface, data model, and design system evolve together. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead front-end architecture and hands-on delivery for the platform's user-facing product, from early prototypes through production.
  • Lead the journey-builder canvas — a direct-manipulation, graph-based interface — as it scales to more complex journeys and larger data volumes.
  • Define API contracts together with the back end lead, so the interface and the data model evolve as one system.
  • Drive the code side of the design system and the design-to-code workflow, in partnership with the product designer, who leads the design system itself.
  • Direct how AI-driven guardrails and model behavior are rendered and made trustworthy in the product.
  • Hire and lead a front-end engineering team as it grows, setting a high bar for code quality and CI-enforced testing.
  • Support and set standards for agentic coding on your team, backed by real company investment in the tools, not just tolerance for their use.
  • Partner with product and design on problem definition, scope, and sequencing from the start of each effort.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What You Should Have:

  • 8+ years in front-end or full-stack engineering, including 2+ years leading a team.
  • Experience leading front-end architecture for a B2B or enterprise product, ideally one with a complex, data-dense, or direct-manipulation UI (a canvas, graph editor, or similar).
  • Track record hiring and growing engineers, and running a technical interview loop from scratch.
  • Comfortable directing and reviewing agentic or AI-assisted coding, with the judgment to know what to hold to human review regardless of how the code was produced.
  • Fluency defining and maintaining API contracts across a team boundary.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous product problems into a sequenced, shippable technical plan.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving, still-small engineering org.
  • Bonus points for pharma or HCP marketing experience — or any complex, regulated marketing data environment (ad tech, financial services marketing, health systems).

 

Pay Range: $175,000-$200,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is seeking a Manager, Human Resources (HR) Operations, Japan to lead the delivery of reliable, consistent, and efficient employee services and HR processes. This people-manager role oversees the day-to-day work of the HR Operations team, translates functional plans into scalable workflows, and resolves operational issues across the employee lifecycle. Reporting to the Director, Human Rescources, Japan, the manager partners closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT and other key stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate, and compliant HR services (dotted line reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations and Technology in the US).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, employee changes, leave coordination, and offboarding, and ensure accurate and timely service.

  • Translate HR policies and functional priorities into documented procedures, controls, service standards, and teamwork plans.

  • Manage HR information system workflows, data quality, reporting, and issue resolution in partnership with HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Communications and IT.

  • Coordinate HR operations vendors, monitor service performance and operating expenses, and address service risks and escalations.

  • Track service metrics and employee feedback, identify recurring issues, and lead continuous improvement of HR operations processes to increase quality, compliance, efficiency, and scalability.

  • Lead the responsible use of technology, including AI and automation, to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve data quality and employee service in partnership with HR, IT, Legal, and data privacy stakeholders.

  • Represent HR Operations in cross-functional and regional or global projects by defining requirements, coordinating dependencies, managing implementation activities, and supporting adoption.

  • Set team goals, assign work, coach team members, support professional development, and reinforce accountability for service delivery.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • A minimum of six years of progressive HR operations experience, including at least two years leading employees or significant operational workstreams.

  • Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, HR systems, data controls, and service delivery.

  • Working knowledge of applicable Japanese employment requirements and employee data privacy practices.

  • Experience managing operational projects, vendors, expenses, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Strong analytical judgment, problem-solving skills, and clear written and verbal communication.

  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English proficiency, with the ability to communicate clearly with employees, leaders, vendors, and global partners.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated, high-growth environment.

  • Experience with Workday or a comparable enterprise HR platform.

  • Experience supporting multi-state or global employee populations.

title: Small to Midsize Strategy Leader - Clinical Data
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Systems is seeking a Strategy Leader responsible for growing the Clinical Data business with the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
The small and medium-sized business (SMB) Strategy Leader of Clinical Data requires a familiarity with clinical research and/or healthcare data flow. The SMB Clinical Data Strategy Leader must demonstrate the ability to drive adoption discussions based on credibility and knowledge across multiple domains, including pharma/biotech, CRO, and technology partnership. The SMB Clinical Data Strategy Leader must demonstrate the ability to challenge customers to adopt new operating models and change their traditional way of thinking.
 
Vault Clinical Data comprises Electronic Data Capture (EDC) and Data Quality System (DQS). This role will be responsible for driving Clinical Data market strategy and growth across our emerging and mid-size  customers, working with the sales team, ensuring customer success, and developing a tailored market approach for customers with small internal teams. To achieve these goals the Strategy Leader of Clinical Data will need to connect with clinical and data management leaders, clinical operations leaders and IT leadership to create strategic plans that deliver and demonstrate customer success, and work directly with sales to identify and win opportunities to grow the business.
 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of industry and technology leaders, who, together, are bringing the next generation of clinical development and R&D applications to Life Sciences.
 
This position can be based anywhere in North America.
 #LI-Remote #LI-Director Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world. Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

  • Content SEO, CMS and editing: support content strategies, maintain WordPress content, and optimize copy for patients and search
  • Keyword research, competitor analysis, and reporting: analyze the German health market and monitor SEO performance using tools such as Google Search Console and Semrush
  • AI search and cross-functional support: explore generative-AI-supported SEO work and collaborate with B2C Marketing and Patient Content

  • How SEO and AI search are applied in a fast-growing health-tech company
  • Practical experience in content optimization, CMS workflows, and SEO analytics
  • How to collaborate across local and international marketing teams

Who you are 

If you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you:

  • Are studying marketing, media, communications, journalism, business administration, or a similar field, can work up to 20 hours per week during the semester, and have excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Speak German C2 and English C1 level; French or Italian is a plus
  • Are familiar with a CMS such as WordPress and with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have first experience in SEO or content marketing and with tools such as Google Search Console or Keyword Planner
  • Have initial experience with Canva or an interest in translation and generative AI
  • Have previous experience in marketing, communications, journalism, editorial work, publishing, or healthcare

  • A flexible working model that allows for hybrid and office-based work

  • 28 vacation days per year (calculated pro rata according to your working schedule)
  • The opportunity to work from EU countries or the UK for up to 10 days per year (eligible after 6 months)

  • Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping
  • A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club

  • Case study Interview 

Job Details

  • Working Student in part-time: up to 20 hours per week 
  • Duration: 12 months
  • Workplace: Berlin
  • Salary: €15 gross/hour - (€16 gross/hour from January 2027)
  • Start date:  November 2026
  • Hybrid setup with 2 office days per week

 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

title: Lead Back End Architect/Engineer
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future.

We are hiring a Lead Engineer, Back End to drive the services and data model that power the platform. You will lead back-end architecture and hands-on delivery, hire and grow a team of back-end and data engineers, and direct how the platform's data scales, stays reliable, and connects to the systems around it. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the platform's application data model in Aurora and DynamoDB, and the access-pattern decisions behind it, as the product scales.
  • Drive the integration contract with our data warehouse — what flows each way, on what cadence — and keep the warehouse out of the platform's request path.
  • Define API contracts together with the front end lead, so the interface and the data model evolve as one system.
  • Direct the reliability, performance, and cost of back-end services, partnering with DevOps on the platform-level non-functional requirements that take both teams' input.
  • Partner with data science to productionize the models and recommendation features built on top of the platform's data.
  • Hire and lead a team of back-end and data engineers, setting a high bar for code quality and CI-enforced testing.
  • Support and set standards for agentic coding on your team, backed by real company investment in the tools, not just tolerance for their use.
  • Partner with product and design on problem definition, scope, and sequencing from the start of each effort.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What You Should Have:

  • 8+ years in back-end or full-stack engineering, including 2+ years leading a team.
  • Experience leading a data model and access patterns for a B2B or enterprise product at meaningful scale, ideally across both a relational and a NoSQL store.
  • Track record hiring and growing engineers, and running a technical interview loop from scratch.
  • Comfortable directing and reviewing agentic or AI-assisted coding, with the judgment to know what to hold to human review regardless of how the code was produced.
  • Experience partnering with data science or ML teams to get models into production.
  • Fluency defining and maintaining API contracts across a team boundary.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving, still-small engineering org.
  • Bonus points for pharma or HCP marketing experience — or any complex, regulated marketing data environment (ad tech, financial services marketing, health systems).

 

Pay Range: $175,000-$200,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

 

 

 

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

*Notice: Real Chemistry and its affiliates' names are being misused by scammers through messaging services, fake websites, and apps. Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud supports strategic business outcomes including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work.

About the Role

We are looking for a Principal Presales Engineer / Solutions Architect to join Nscale’s commercial organisation and play a key role in helping customers understand, evaluate, and adopt our AI infrastructure solutions.

This is a deeply technical, customer-facing role at the intersection of sales, solution design, and AI infrastructure. You will partner closely with account executives, product, engineering, and operations teams to support the full sales cycle, from discovery and technical qualification through solution design, product demonstrations, proof of concept support, and customer onboarding.

You will need to quickly become fluent in Nscale’s infrastructure, platform capabilities, and software orchestration stack so that you can confidently present our solutions, map customer requirements to technical architectures, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the buying journey.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical credibility with commercial instinct, enjoys engaging directly with customers, and can translate complex GPU, AI, and cloud concepts into clear business value.

What You’ll Do

  • Support the commercial team in qualifying customer opportunities and identifying technical requirements early in the sales process
  • Deliver compelling product demos, technical presentations, workshops, and architecture sessions for prospective customers and partners
  • Translate customer AI, HPC, and infrastructure requirements into clear solution designs using Nscale’s platform
  • Develop and present solution proposals that align technical architecture with customer business outcomes
  • Work closely with customers to understand workloads, deployment requirements, performance expectations, and scaling plans
  • Build a strong working knowledge of Nscale’s infrastructure stack, GPU cloud platform, APIs, orchestration tooling, and deployment models
  • Support proof of concepts, evaluations, onboarding projects, and technical validation activities
  • Partner with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure proposed solutions are realistic, scalable, and aligned with platform standards
  • Provide guidance on compute, networking, storage, orchestration, and workload optimisation for AI and machine learning use cases
  • Help create repeatable demo environments, technical playbooks, reference architectures, and sales enablement materials
  • Act as a technical voice in the commercial organisation, helping shape how Nscale positions its solutions in the market
  • Surface customer feedback, product gaps, and recurring technical objections to internal stakeholders
  • Support RFQ, BOM, and technical proposal development where required for larger or more complex opportunities

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in presales engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering, cloud architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role
  • Strong ability to present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience supporting enterprise or mid-market sales cycles in infrastructure, cloud, AI, data centre, or platform environments
  • Good understanding of cloud infrastructure, GPU compute, AI/ML workloads, or high-performance infrastructure
  • Familiarity with containers, Kubernetes, Slurm, orchestration platforms, or workload deployment models
  • Understanding of networking, storage, and distributed compute concepts in modern infrastructure environments
  • Ability to quickly learn a complex technical platform and confidently represent it externally
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work cross-functionally across sales, engineering, product, and operations
  • Commercial awareness and the ability to link technical solution design to customer outcomes and deal progression
  • Strong written skills for creating solution overviews, proposals, diagrams, and customer-facing technical content

Nice to Have

  • Terraform or related orchestration and automation tools
  • Experience delivering technical product demos in a presales or partner-facing environment
  • Experience supporting AI start-ups, research organisations, model builders, or enterprise AI teams
  • Understanding of high-performance networking concepts such as InfiniBand, RDMA, or RoCE
  • Experience working with APIs, developer platforms, or cloud-native application environments
  • Experience with open-weight model training and inference

What Success Looks Like

  • You can confidently demo Nscale’s platform and explain its value to both technical and commercial stakeholders
  • You become a trusted technical partner to the sales team and help accelerate qualified opportunities
  • You can quickly assess customer requirements and map them to practical, compelling solution designs and architectures
  • You help improve win rates by addressing technical objections with clarity and

title: Group Copy Supervisor
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.


About the role
 
The Group Copy Supervisor plays an integral role in driving the creative development of high-quality copy and content for Avalere Health and one or more of our great clients. You will partner with other members of the creative team to develop copy and content, working closely with strategy, medical, client services, and other members of the team in these efforts. You will work together with the broader team to not only ensure our clients’ needs are met, but to strive to surpass their expectations.
 
Note: a portfolio featuring your pharma agency work must be submitted along with your resume.
 What we can offer You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Consultant
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Systems, a leader in cloud-based solutions for the global life sciences industry, is looking for a Project Management Consultant to join our Clinical Data Professional Services team. title: In Vivo Research Associate II, Konermann Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking an In Vivo Research Associate II to join the Konermann Laboratory at the Arc Institute.You will collaborate closely with experienced scientists to advance in vivo projects focused on understanding brain development.

This project builds on previous work in genome-scale CRISPR screening (Konermann et al., 2015; Biering et al., 2021; Wei et al., 2023; Roohani et al., 2025) and aims to combine modern functional genomics and neuroscience tools to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying brain development and function. The ideal candidate will have experience in animal handling and colony management, intracerebral injections, sample processing for single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial pipelines, and imaging. This position offers an excellent opportunity for candidates considering PhD programs, as it involves participation in all stages of a research project under the guidance of an experienced scientist.

About You

  • You love science and learning. Whether it's a new field or a new bench technique, you stay curious and enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone.
  • You are detail-oriented. You're careful and diligent about documentation and good lab practice, and you like keeping things organized.
  • You collaborate and help others. Science is a team effort, and you take the initiative to pitch in.
  • You are a problem solver. Experiments rarely work the first time. You bring patience and confidence to complex technical troubleshooting.

 In this position, you will

  • Plan, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments with a high degree of independence, with continued support from the rest of the team
  • Perform in vivo mouse experiments, including stereotaxic surgeries, as well as IV and IP injections
  • Collect and process tissue, including vibratome and/or cryostat sectioning, immunostaining, and imaging
  • Comply with federal, Arc, and local IACUC/AAALAC regulations governing animal research
  • Follow Arc's standards for code of conduct, safety, and the handling of hazardous materials, biological materials, and controlled substances
  • Analyze and present data at subgroup meetings and seminars
  • Maintain an organized, detailed lab notebook

Job Requirements

  • BS with 2+ years of relevant experience, or MS, in molecular biology, neuroscience, or another relevant field. Relevant experience includes independent lab work during undergraduate studies
  • Strong experience working with laboratory animals, including handling, restraint, and procedures under an approved protocol (intracranial, IV, and IP injections, as well as perfusions)
  • Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Highly motivated and curious, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Ability to work some weekends as needed (days off can be swapped for weekdays

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience with cloning via Gibson assembly or Golden Gate protocols (library cloning experience is a plus)
  • Knowledge of and experience with NGS library preparation, particularly single-cell and spatial workflows
  • Computational skills (Python or R)

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.
